rendered: The TGA-DTG data for the recovered NMC622 show the organic coating layer and carbon black (CB) being burned off. The organic coating layer loses ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[1] and the CB loses ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[2]. Both are removed by calcining in air at 600 °C[3]. These are the text's approximate values for the TGA-DTG curves.
